blocks.title: Acid rain
blocks.text: Taqreeban 5 se 6 se kam pH wali barish (rain, barf, sleet ya ole) acid rain hai.

Fossil fuels jalana SOx aur NOx fiza mein chhorta hai; yeh gases nami se mil kar acids banati hain, aur hawa tezabi qatron ko bohat door le ja sakti hai is se pehle ke woh acid rain, ole, barf ya dhund ke taur par zameen par wapas aayein. Acid rain saaf barish jaisi dikhti, mehsoos hoti aur zaiqa rakhti hai, magar us ki galane wali nau'iyat mahol ko wasee nuqsan deti hai. Aham reactions: fossil fuels ki SO2 SO3 mein oxidise hoti hai, 2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g), jo pani se react kar ke sulfuric acid deti hai, SO3(g) + H2O(l) se H2SO4(aq); nitrogen oxide pani se react kar ke nitric aur nitrous acids deta hai, 2NO2 + H2O se HNO3 + HNO2 (print NO ke saath likhti hai).

blocks.prompt: Acid rain banne ke bunyadi kimiyai amal kya hain, aur fiza ke sulfur trioxide se sulfuric acid ka state symbols ke saath balanced muadla likhein (exercise Q.2j; Quick Check 14.3c).
blocks.explanation: Fuels jalne ki sulfur dioxide hawa mein sulfur trioxide mein oxidise hoti hai, 2SO2 + O2 se 2SO3, aur trioxide pani ke qatron mein halti hai: SO3(g) + H2O(l) se H2SO4(aq). Nitrogen oxides nitric aur nitrous acids mein halte hain, 2NO2(g) + H2O(l) se HNO3(aq) + HNO2(aq). Acids taqreeban 5 se kam pH ki barish, barf ya dhund ke taur par girte hain.

items: Acid rain: fossil fuels ke SOx aur NOx se 5-6 se kam pH ki barish; 2SO2 + O2 se 2SO3, SO3 + H2O se H2SO4, 2NO2 + H2O se HNO3 + HNO2; hawa door le jati hai; ecosystems aur imarton ko galati hai.
